Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ho...@intergate.bc.ca (Michal Kranc) writes:

>Q #1. At what point in the game exactly i get the 6 pool for ousting my prey
>>ie>right away , or end of the current players turn ?

Right away (unless you are ousted at the same time).

>Q #2. If i play IMMORTAL GRAPPLE in combat , does the opponent still get the
>bonus for weapons that give + X hand damage ?

No. The horribly confusing template used by post-Jyhad Melee weapons
should be taken to mean the same as: "Melee Weapon. Strike: +X hand damage"

That is, the weapon doesn't simply pass a hand-damage bonus to it's
bearer (as card text suggests), but must be used as a strike to have any
effect.

>Q #3. If i block a TOREADOR with ACHING BEUTY on it , do i still have to pay
>the 1 pool for blocking even if the opponent plays CHANGE OF TARGET ? ( change
>of target cancels the action therefore the blocking never occured )

Yes. Blocking still occurs. Change of Target says nothing about cancelling
the block - it cancels the action and the block-induced-combat.

>Q #4. Can u put more pool on an uncontrolled vampire then it's capacity ?

Yes.

>Q #5. Do i replace the vote cards that i've used to throw in for votes A)at the
>end of my turn B) at the end of the current plyers turn ?

The end of the current turn.

>Q #6. If i attemp to block an acting vampire , and he plays superior FACELESS
>NIGHT , do i need to play another wake in order to be able to attempt to block
>the action again ?

No. Faceless night only taps potential blockers "when the action is
resolved/blocked" (errata).

>Q #7. What is the next expansion for V:tES going to be ?

? Sometime after support is re-instated for the current game and expansions,
I hope.
